<?php
$curl = curl_init();
curl_setopt_array($curl, [
    CURLOPT_URL => 'https://api.test/pets?limit=10',
    CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
    CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'GET',
    CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => ['Accept: application/json', 'X-Token: abc'],
]);
$response = curl_exec($curl);
curl_close($curl);
echo $response;
